item.text:
Implemented `formatDuration(totalSeconds)` in [src/duration.js](C:\Users\bash\AppData\Local\Temp\offcut-bench-work-QxrKA6\repo/src/duration.js).

- Formats hours, minutes, and seconds compactly.
- Floors fractional seconds.
- Returns `"0s"` for zero.
- Throws `TypeError` for negative, non-finite, or non-number inputs.
- Verified representative cases with Node assertions and `git diff --check`.
